maintenance_led.reason: Largest segment Healthcare sells consumables and capital equipment like sterilizers and surgical tables; services and maintenance are a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private and nonprofit hospitals, pharma and medical device makers; government-funded hospitals are a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through product sales, services and recurring demand; acquisitions like Cantel are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Sterilizers, reprocessors and sterility assurance are regulation-critical in hospitals and pharma; switching needs requalification, training and risks downtime.

notes: Revenue mix between consumables, capital equipment and services is judged from general knowledge; the website text gives no figures.
